msg: What if I decide to stay one day longer in rosario, can you provide de transfer back to cartagena?
reply:
Hi again! Staying an extra day in the Rosario Islands sounds wonderful — such a beautiful place to relax. 🌞

If you’re already on the islands and your hotel has maritime access, we can definitely pick you up and take you back to your hotel on the islands at no extra charge. However, transport from the Rosario Islands back to Cartagena is not included in the diving packages.

For your transfer back to Cartagena after your extended stay, the hotel or local boat services usually arrange that separately. We can help coordinate your diving activities while you’re on the islands, but the boat transfer back to Cartagena is outside our dive service packages.

Which hotel are you staying at? I can help you with more details or connect you with the right options!
